  <h1>Bayesian Working Group</h1>
  <p class="masthead__alt">Grupo de Trabajo en Inferencia Bayesiana</p>
  <p class="lead">A working group of the Spanish Society of Statistics, Operations Research and Data Science (SEIO), constituted at the XXXVI SEIO Congress in Toledo in 2016.</p>
</header>

<section class="section">
  <div class="layout">
    <p class="label">In brief</p>
    <dl class="facts">
      <div><dt>Constituted</dt><dd>2016, at the XXXVI SEIO Congress (Toledo)</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Parent society</dt><dd><a href="https://www.seio.es/">Sociedad de Estadística e Investigación Operativa</a></dd></div>
      <div><dt>Coordination</dt><dd>Roi Naveiro (CUNEF Universidad) and M. Remedios Sillero-Denamiel (Universidad de Sevilla)</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Board</dt><dd>Concepción Ausín, Stefano Cabras, Gonzalo García-Donato, Pepa Ramírez-Cobo</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Contact</dt><dd><a href="mailto:roi.naveiro@cunef.edu">roi.naveiro@cunef.edu</a> · <a href="mailto:rsillero@us.es">rsillero@us.es</a></dd></div>
    </dl>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section">
  <div class="layout">
    <p class="label">Purpose</p>
    <div class="prose">
      <p>The stated aim of the group is to promote research in Bayesian inference and to disseminate its results among SEIO members, in the scientific community and in society at large.</p>
      <p>Its activity consists mainly of scientific sessions at the SEIO national congresses and of the International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics, held for the first time in 2024 and for the second in 2026. Sessions reserved for early-career researchers are a regular part of both.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section">
  <div class="layout">
    <p class="label">Membership</p>
    <div class="prose">
      <p>Membership is open to SEIO members who work on or with Bayesian methods. To join the group, to correct an entry in the internal directory or to propose an activity, write to the coordinators at <a href="mailto:roi.naveiro@cunef.edu">roi.naveiro@cunef.edu</a> or <a href="mailto:rsillero@us.es">rsillero@us.es</a>.</p>
      <p>Membership of the Society itself is handled by <a href="https://www.seio.es/membership/individual-member/">SEIO</a>.</p>
